summary: Several helpers restate existing Mathlib/TauCeti API verbatim: the private division helpers are `Int.dvd_div_of_mul_dvd`/`Int.dvd_mul_of_div_dvd`, the `hσγ` proof is the imported `σ_mapGL_real_eq_refl`, the q-expansion HasSum term is `ModularForm.hasSum_qExpansion` word for word, and the Bézout witness is `Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.isCoprime_col`. Two of the file's own divisibility lemmas are also special cases of its later `dvd_lower_left_of_dvd`.
